title: Projection and coordinate Laplacian sum
statement: Let $\Omega$ be a finite set with probability mass function $\pi$, let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $i$ be a coordinate, and let $f:\Omega^n\to\mathbb R$. The coordinate projection of $f$ onto all coordinates except $i$, plus the coordinate Laplacian of $f$ at $i$, equals $f$.
hypotheses_covered: $\pi$ is a probability mass function on $\Omega$
